text:
Jordan Lee: Heads-up: hitting duplicate resource creates from our async SDK when the client retries on stream-read failures.
Jordan Lee: Minimal: AsyncClient + timeout=0.2 + server returns 502 mid-stream -> SDK retries and second attempt loses the idempotency header.
Ravi Patel: do we have an internal repro? sync vs async parity check?
Jordan Lee: repro attached inline. it's small and deterministic with httpx.MockTransport.
Jordan Lee: repro gist: 
```
import uuid
import httpx
from redwood import AsyncClient, RetryPolicy

async def test_dup_create():
    seen = []
    async def handler(req):
        seen.append(req.headers.get('X-Idempotency-Key'))
        if len(seen) == 1:
            # simulate streaming failure
            raise httpx.ReadTimeout('sim')
        return httpx.Response(201, json={'id': 'created'})

    transport = httpx.MockTransport(handler)
    client = AsyncClient(transport=transport, retry=RetryPolicy(max_retries=2, backoff=0.05))
    async with client:
        key = uuid.uuid4().hex
        await client.create_resource({'name':'z'}, idempotency_key=key, timeout=0.2)
    assert seen == [key, key]
```
Jordan Lee: today second value ends up None which is the duplication trigger.
Anya Gomez: OK suspected cause: for async we rebuild the Request body/stream and call RequestBuilder again; headers are derived from request.metadata which apparently isn't deep-copied.
Priya Nair: typing note: our public method signature currently has idempotency_key: Any = None. We should tighten to Optional[str] and enforce string coercion in one place.
Ravi Patel: proposed fixes: 1) attach idempotency header on the Retry wrapper before each retry attempt (explicit copy), 2) ensure auto-generated idempotency token is seeded once per call and stored immutable on call-context.
Anya Gomez: agree. Also recommend switching backoff default from constant to decorrelated jitter (exponential backoff with jitter) to avoid synchronized retries causing duplicate loads.
Jordan Lee: PR plan: small change in retry.py to read request.context.get('idempotency_key') and set prepared.headers['X-Idempotency-Key']=value if present; add unit test using MockTransport + ReadTimeout -> assert both outbound headers equal. Also add integration test that verifies server-side dedupe (simulate idempotent server that returns same id on replay).
Priya Nair: watch type surfaces in types.py: request.context annotated Mapping[str, Any]; changing behavior to write may require creating a shallow copy of the metadata dict and updating types -> MutableMapping. Add my review once PR is up.
Ravi Patel: one more: consider adding metrics for retries that resulted in 'non-idempotent' operations so we can monitor regression in prod (counter for duplicate creates).
Jordan Lee: created GH issue (internal): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/PRIVATE-1102 with repro and suggested patch.
Anya Gomez: CI: include test in flaky/test_retry.py so it runs under async test harness. Also add a small note in the 0.9.x changelog describing the bug and workaround (explicitly setting idempotency_key).
ci-bot: queued tests for branch jordan/async-idemp-fix #sdk-tests
Priya Nair: thanks, this looks actionable. Jordan, assign me as reviewer and mark changeset small/patch.
Jordan Lee: will do. aim to have PR + tests today. will ping here when ready.
Ravi Patel: nice catch. Also open question: server-side idempotency vs client header behavior — doc spike maybe to recommend server fallback if header missing.
Jordan Lee: agreed. we'll include guidance in SDK docs and sample app.
Anya Gomez: thx all. :thumbsup:
